Hi @FabienMotte ,

We don't have customice nothing, with filters just work you can see it in the demo that I made. Look:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13077343/236157531-5489b78e-f674-4e77-9886-31627d4aeac7.mov

Thanks
